instruction: A candid, clean studio photograph in a medium shot showing two women playing a hand-clapping game against a plain beige backdrop. On the left, the woman with short brown hair (R2) in a striped shirt and beige pants sits facing right, smiling warmly. On the right, the woman with dark curly afro hair (R1) in a purple long-sleeve shirt sits facing left, also smiling. They look at each other as the woman with short brown hair's left hand touches the woman with dark curly afro hair's right hand in a high-five, with their other hands raised in the air. The scene is illuminated by soft, even studio lighting, creating a warm and joyful atmosphere.
elements: R2's left hand touches R1's right hand in the high-five contact
